title: 案例复盘：低端机内存水位过低导致卡顿
key_conclusions: Low watermarks can cause foreground direct reclaim and user-visible jank before lmkd has time to help.
A kill that lowers PSI after the symptom is a recovery event, not necessarily the root cause.
The case must prove allocstall, PSI full, and Perfetto frame misses before claiming a watermark timing problem.
A one-knob watermark experiment is the only defensible way to validate the fix.
shallow_points: The case uses representative evidence patterns rather than a real captured device trace.
It does not provide numeric baseline and candidate sysctl values for a specific RAM class.
It does not include a ready-to-run Perfetto trace config.
It does not quantify acceptable changes in kill rate, ZRAM, and recovery latency.
discovered_connections: Day 61's T0-T5 lab timeline gives the case its causal structure.
Day 62's one-knob tuning discipline prevents the case from becoming unreviewable.
Day 63's protection boundaries help exclude foreground-service or high-adj abuse before blaming watermarks.
Day 65 should use the same timing discipline when a high-priority process is killed.
suggest_future_topics: Day 65 should replay lmkd high-priority kill with pressure, priority, source-bucket, and victim-benefit worksheets.
A future appendix should add a real trace bundle and numeric low-RAM watermark experiment.
A future lab tool should generate the case report table automatically from pressure.tsv, logcat, and Perfetto exports.
Day 68 should revisit this case when attributing Native/System buckets that are invisible in app-only meminfo.
knowledge_gaps: Need real low-end device traces where allocstall and frame misses precede lmkd kill.
Need safe candidate ranges for watermark_scale_factor and min_free_kbytes by device class.
Need validated Perfetto query templates for direct reclaim and frame deadline correlation.
Need measured side effects on app recovery latency and background process survival.
